isolation_notes: Executed in an existing user conversation, not a new user chat or clean-room run.

Parent disclosed a prior full everyday benchmark in the same conversation using the same fixture. This freshly scoped worker did not read previous output files or prior numeric results; it independently downloaded and computed the bundled input.

Only local task files, the authorized archive download, and the existing spreadsheet skill were used. No browser, native desktop, memory, scheduler, cart, account, installation, benchmark harness or benchmark API was used.

deviations: CSV-only deliverables were requested. No workbook was created; CSV parsing and exact decimal/integer-cent processing used the existing Python runtime and standard library.

The source ZIP SHA256 and all nine manifest file hashes were verified. The operator supplied pinned commit 49cb2bb4cf4b5786d476fd5a6cbf1eaf8e012817; the release archive contains no commit attestation, so correspondence of that commit to the archive was not independently verified.
Host clock uses UTC; benchmark run_config retains America/New_York. Source dates were preserved unchanged and no date-sensitive scheduling was performed.

Duration measurements use observed UTC wall-clock boundaries at one-second precision, not a CPU timer. The conservative active interval includes relevant reading after source inspection, but excludes initial download/setup and subsequent report writing. Tool count covers disclosed worker tool operations through artifact verification, including setup, and excludes orchestration wrappers, coordination messages and reporting/delivery operations. Backend and parent-conversation totals and token counts are unavailable.
